title: Channel card: chain and power
comments: Audio 34-pin and power 8-pin ribbons, IN and OUT wired straight through (docs/CHAIN.md)
LM317/LM337 to +/-15.1 V (200R/2k2, 10uF ADJ), 78L05 +5 V for logic and LEDs
Input caps to PGND; dividers, output caps and SS14 rail clamps to AGND
Estimated load about 130 mA per rail: about 0.7 W in each TO-220 regulator
